title: share answer
description: The memory tool share's answer (SB-P3-10): a memory moved between its owner's private scope and Family, or unchanged when it is there already. A write's shape: no memory's words, only where it is now and what moved with it (scope, and project and capsule when they changed); replayed is always false and dropped_tags empty. A held memory's answer names no project, and neither does an answer to a caller that does not read where the memory landed (an admin who took it back). Listed and answered only with memory.tools and memory.share on, and refused (scopes_off) while memory.scopes is off (contracts/README.md 2.1). The JSON in its text content, and on success the same as its structured content; a refusal is isError true with the refusal body.
